rule: err = body.error, code = err.code || err.type || "". If code matches usage_limit_reached|usage_not_included|rate_limit_exceeded or status is 429: kind rate_limit, until = err.resets_at*1000 or null, message = "You have hit your ChatGPT usage limit" + (plan_type ? " ("+lowercase(plan_type)+" plan)" : "") + "." + (resets_at ? " Try again in ~"+max(0, round((resets_at*1000-now)/60000))+" min." : ""). Else 401/403 -> signed_out; 500/502/503/504 -> overloaded; else null. For non-rate kinds until is null and message = err.message, else the raw body, else "Request failed".
